xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) had issued an order dated January 17, 2025 for payment of Rs. 3,68,864 (Rupees Three Lacs Twenty Sixty Eight Thousand Eight Hundred Sixty Four) with respect to compounding contraventions of certain provisions of the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 and the regulations issued thereunder during the financial years ranging from 2006-09 and 2014-17.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The Company had filed an application to RBI for compounding of (i) delay in reporting of remittance received in the financial year 2006-07, (ii) delay in submission of form FCGPR w.r.t. issuance of shares during the financial years ranging from 2006-09 and 2014-17, (iii) issue of shares prior to receipt of remittance in the financial year 2016-17 and (iv) delay in refund of excess remittance amount received in the financial year 2007-08 in terms of Para 9(1 )(A), Para 9(1 )(B), and Para 8 of Schedule 1 respectively to Foreign Exchange Management (Transfer or Issue of Security by a Person Resident Outside India) Regulations, 2000 notified vide Notification No. FEMA 20/ 2000-RB dated May 03, 2000, hereinafter referred to as FEMA 20/ 2000-RB), as then applicable.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The financial impact on the Company is limited to the extent of Rs. 3,68,864 (Rupees Three Lacs Twenty Sixty Eight Thousand Eight Hundred Sixty Four), Compounding fee paid by the Company. There is no impact on operations or other activities of the Company.
